data.plainLyric:
(Ji, ro, lu, pat, hey!)

Mangan tempe rasane
Koyo mangan lawuh sate
Senajan sak anane
Sing penting ro kowe

Ngombe kembang tahu rasane
Koyo ngombe susu (syala-la-la-la)
Ra usah mecucu
Tresnoku ro kowe
Ra bakal tak madu

Bungah tenan rasane
Wong kang lagi gandrung (lagi gandrung)
Tak perjuangke
Tekan janur melengkung

Kowe siji-sijine
Aku bangga karo kowe
Gelem nompo opo anane
Tresnoku ra bakal mletre

Kowe ojo sumelang
Tresnoku ra bakal ilang
Ibarat koyo kuthoku Jogja
